descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi sei In qualità di specialista del supporto tecnico, garantisci il corretto funzionamento e la continuità aziendale dei prodotti digitali e dei servizi IT in tutto lo Store di Lyssach. Combini il supporto pratico con la manutenzione proattiva e la collaborazione delle parti interessate.
• Esperienza nel supporto IT, servizi tecnici o alta passione in questo campo
• Solida conoscenza di hardware, software e infrastruttura IT
• Familiarità con la gestione dei servizi IT, i processi e gli strumenti IKEA
• Forti capacità di problem solving e capacità di lavorare in autonomia
• Orientato al cliente con ottime capacità comunicative
• Capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico
• Comprensione di base della gestione del progetto e del cambiamento
• Interesse per l'innovazione digitale e le tecnologie emergenti
• Conoscenza fluente del tedesco e buona comprensione dell'inglese Le tue responsabilità
• Garantire la disponibilità di prodotti e piattaforme digitali
• Gestire il ciclo di vita delle risorse IT (inventario, approvvigionamento, distribuzione)
• Fornire supporto di 2° livello per hardware e software
• Supporto di implementazioni, aggiornamenti e nuove configurazioni del sito
• Eseguire il monitoraggio e la manutenzione preventiva
• Risolvere e dare priorità agli incidenti, segnalare quando necessario
• Sostenere progetti e implementazioni globali
• Formare il personale in loco e i nuovi assunti Pensi che funzionerebbe per te? Vogliamo che i nostri dipendenti siano felici e in salute. Significa anche dire "grazie"! Il nostro modo di dire grazie: •28 giorni di ferie (sulla base di un carico di lavoro del 100%) •8 settimane retribuite
descriptionByLocale.en:
Who you are As a Technical Support Specialist, you ensure the smooth operation and business continuity of digital products and IT services across the Store in Lyssach. You combine hands-on support with proactive maintenance and stakeholder collaboration.
• Experience in IT support, technical services, or high passion within this Field
• Solid understanding of hardware, software, and IT infrastructure
• Familiarity with IT service management, IKEA processes and tools
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
• Customer-oriented with excellent communication skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
• Basic understanding of project and change management
• Interest in digital innovation and emerging technologies
• Fluent in German and good understanding in English Your responsibilities
• Ensure availability of digital products and platforms
• Manage IT asset lifecycle (inventory, procurement, deployment)
• Provide 2nd-level support for hardware and software
• Support rollouts, upgrades, and new site setups
• Perform monitoring and preventive maintenance
• Resolve and prioritize incidents, escalate when needed
• Support projects and global deployments
• Train on-site staff and new hires Do you think that would work for you? We want our employees to be happy and healthy. It also means saying 'thank you'! Our way of saying thank you: •28 vacation days (based on a 100% workload) •8 weeks paid parental leave for fathers; 20 weeks paid parental leave for mothers •Very attractive social benefits •15% staff discount on your purchase - in every Swiss IKEA store •You would rather travel to work by public transport? We pay between 85% and 100% of your yearly travel ticket •Free parking facilities •Unlimited access to the LinkedIn learning platform •Affordable and healthy meals in our staff canteen (CHF 4.50 for meat dishes and CHF 3.50 for veggie dishes) •Bonus payments for all employees There are many opportunities for career development at IKEA. We encourage and support our employees to try out different roles, move between functions or even go abroad. Please submit your full application online via our website, please note however that we cannot consider applications and documents sent by email or post. That's it from us. That was a lot of information. We'd love to find out more about you. Just click on 'Apply now' and off you go. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may stop the application process as soon as we have found the right person. So please apply as soon as possible.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Qui vous êtes En tant que spécialiste du support technique, vous assurez le bon fonctionnement et la continuité des activités des produits numériques et des services informatiques dans l'ensemble du magasin de Lyssach. Vous combinez une assistance pratique avec une maintenance proactive et une collaboration avec les parties prenantes.
• Expérience dans le support informatique, les services techniques ou une grande passion dans ce domaine
• Solide compréhension du matériel, des logiciels et de l'infrastructure informatique
• Connaissance de la gestion des services informatiques, des processus et des outils IKEA
• Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité à travailler de manière autonome
• Orienté client avec d'excellentes compétences en communication
• Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement dynamique
• Compréhension de base de la gestion de projet et du changement
• Intérêt pour l'innovation numérique et les technologies émergentes
• Maîtrise de l'allemand et bonne compréhension de l'anglais Vos responsabilités
• Assurer la disponibilité des produits et plateformes numériques
• Gérer le cycle de vie des actifs informatiques (inventaire, approvisionnement, déploiement)
• Fournir un support de 2ème niveau pour le matériel et les logiciels
• Prend en charge les déploiements, les mises à niveau et les nouvelles configurations de site
• Effectuer la surveillance et la maintenance préventive
• Résoudre et hiérarchiser les incidents, remonter au besoin
• Soutenir les projets et les déploiements mondiaux
• Former le personnel sur place et les nouvelles recrues Pensez-vous que cela fonctionnerait pour vous ? Nous voulons que nos employés soient heureux et en bonne santé. Cela signifie aussi dire « merci » ! Notre façon de vous remercier : •28 jours de vacances (sur la base d'une charge de travail de 100%) •8 semaines payées
